San Miguel Corporation started in 1890 as _La Fábrica de Cerveza de San Miguel_, Southeast Asia's first brewery. Founded by Enrique María Barreto in the San Miguel district of Manila, it later incorporated in 1913 and adopted its current name in 1964 after expanding far beyond its brewing roots. [](https://www.sanmiguel.com.ph/page/our-history)

-   **1890:** Established as a small single-product brewery under a Spanish Royal Charter.

-   **1910s:** Grew into a regional icon, exporting beer to Shanghai, Hong Kong, and Guam.

-   **1963–1964:** Shortened and changed its corporate name to **San Miguel Corporation**.

-   **2008:** Shifted into an aggressive diversification strategy, moving into fuel, oil, energy, infrastructure, and cement. [](https://www.sanmiguel.com.ph/our-story/our-company)
